note: Regional park in a small treed valley just off Hwy 11 at Craik, beside the Craik Reservoir (Arm Lake) with its boat launch; a kidney-shaped outdoor swimming pool, mini golf, disc golf and a nine-hole grass-greens golf course across the road. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park). WATERFRONT pond -> not waterfront: the 'recreational pond' is the park's fenced, asphalt-bottomed kidney-shaped swimming pool (~70 x 55 m); the reservoir and creek are across Hwy 11. 58 serviced sites (10 seasonal) + tent; Let's Camp sells 46 nightly 30 A + water. C$35 (2026), entry C$8. Sewer -> false (seasonal only). Season May long wknd - Sept long wknd. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: pond -> not waterfront (downgrade). The 'recreational pond' in the stored evidence is the park's swimming pool: saskregionalparks - 'Public swimming and swimming lessons are offered in our unique kidney shaped pool that is shallow on all sides with an asphalt bottom' ('The unique kidney shaped swimming pool ... opened in August of 1967'). Esri z18 shows it at ~51.0612,-105.7970 as a kidney-shaped green basin ~70 x 55 m (well under 5 acres) ringed by a fence/deck with its building on the SE edge.
